---
title: "`panzoom` on every figure"
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - path: ../../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
---

panzoom takes every image lightbox would take on its own, so no image needs to
be marked. The `lightbox:` option in the YAML header sets up lightbox too, but
only cells that ask for it with the `#| lightbox: true` cell option, or with
lightbox options such as `group`, open in it. The same cases open in lightbox
alone on the [lightbox page](a-lightbox.html). The YAML header sets up both, and
turns off the hint line:

```yaml
---
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
---
```

## Single image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-desc-position="left"}

A markdown image with a description and `desc-position="left"`. It opens in
panzoom, with the caption and description in a panel on the left of the image.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Sunset at Chilmark Beach, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left" fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}
```

## Gallery in a layout {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three images in a layout, joined by `group="elsewhere"`. Each opens in panzoom,
in one three-image gallery.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Waves breaking below the clay cliffs at Aquinnah, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah." fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages." fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}

![Edgartown Lighthouse, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse." fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}
:::
```

## Math {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with math in its caption and description. It opens in panzoom,
with both typeset.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$" fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach"}
```

## Markdown subfigures {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

A figure with two markdown subfigures. Either one opens in panzoom, in a
two-image gallery. The figure's caption links to the heat map in [case
12](#c12).

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Aquinnah](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

![Edgartown Lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}

Aquinnah and Edgartown Lighthouse, on Martha's Vineyard. For heights of Maunga Whau instead, see @fig-plain.
:::
```

## R subfigures {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

One R cell with two plots, made subfigures by `fig-subcap`. Either one opens in
panzoom, in a two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Vapor pressure of mercury, and stopping distances of cars.
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| fig-alt:
#|   - "Scatter plot of vapor pressure rising steeply with temperature"
#|   - "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## Cell options {#c6 expect-open="glightbox"}

Two R cells, joined by `group: r-graph` under the `lightbox` cell option. Asking
for lightbox keeps them out of panzoom, so either plot opens in lightbox, in a
two-image gallery, with its own description on the right.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of ten random points"
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Ten random points against their index.
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: Ten random points.

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Stopping distance against speed for 50 cars.
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: Stopping distance against speed.

plot(cars)
```

## Two plots in one cell {#c7 expect-open="glightbox"}

One R cell with two plots, each with its own caption and description, joined by
`group: cars` under the `lightbox` cell option. Either one opens in lightbox, in
a two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| fig-alt:
#|   - >-
#|     Scatterplot matrix of the mtcars data, each variable plotted against
#|     every other
#|   - "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "The mtcars data, each variable plotted against every other."
#|   - "Stopping distance against speed for 50 cars."
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - The mtcars data, each variable against every other.
#|     - Stopping distance against speed.

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## Opt out {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

An R cell with `lightbox: false`. Neither lightbox nor panzoom takes it, so
clicking it does nothing.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "The mtcars data, each variable plotted against every other."
#| lightbox: false
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Scatterplot matrix of the mtcars data, each variable plotted against every
#|   other

plot(mtcars)
```

## Image in a link {#c9 expect-open="navigation"}

An image inside a link. panzoom leaves linked images alone and keeps lightbox
from dropping the link, so clicking the image follows the link.

```markdown {.show-source}
[![A sailboat off Edgartown, linked to quarto.org.](../../images/mv-4.jpg){width=30% fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach, with an unrelated link to open the Quarto website"}](https://quarto.org)
```

## Margin image {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image in the margin. It opens in panzoom, as any other block image
does.

```markdown {.show-source}
![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.column-margin fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}
```

## Inline image {#c11 expect-open="nothing"}

An image inside a sentence. `match: auto` skips inline images, as lightbox does,
so clicking it does nothing.

```markdown {.show-source}
Some text with an inline image ![A white lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){width=60px} in the middle.
```

## Plain R figure {#c12 expect-open="panzoom"}

Heights of Maunga Whau (Mount Eden), from pale yellow (low) to dark red (high).
The caption of [case 4](#c4) links to it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Heat map of the Maunga Whau volcano's heights, in yellow, orange, and red
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Heights of Maunga Whau (Mount Eden), from pale yellow (low) to dark red
#|   (high).

image(volcano)
```
